title: Changes in expression of DNA-methyltransferase in neovascular age-related macular degeneration: Anti-VEGF response or disease severity?

sections.title: 研究问题
sections.text:
《Changes in expression of DNA-methyltransferase in neovascular age-related macular degeneration: Anti-VEGF response or disease severity?》：研究问题的原文依据。

【Purpose · abstract-1-1】Recent studies suggest distinct patterns of DNA methyltransferase (DNMT) expression across different stages of age-related macular degeneration (AMD). However, whether these variations can be modulated by conventional therapeutic approaches remains unexplored. This study investigates DNMT expression dynamics in two patients with exudative neovascular AMD (nAMD) during the initial months of anti-VEGF treatment.

【Purpose · abstract-1-1】Recent studies suggest distinct patterns of DNA methyltransferase (DNMT) expression across different stages of age-related macular degeneration (AMD). However, whether these variations can be modulated by conventional therapeutic approaches remains unexplored. This study investigates DNMT expression dynamics in two patients with exudative neovascular AMD (nAMD) during the initial months of anti-VEGF treatment.

【Conclusions · abstract-3-1】We hereby report varying DNMTs expression in nAMD patients with different disease manifestations giving new insights into the dynamic nature of epigenetic modifications in response to anti-VEGF treatment.
